title: Authorize Student V0.1 Wave 1 launch package
purpose: Persist the shared interface freeze, subordinate Wave 1 work packages, execution prompts and coordination state needed to launch three disjoint Student V0.1 implementation workers from one exact post-launch base without changing product, contract, authoring or workflow implementation.
invariants: No product/runtime/UI/authoring/contract/workflow implementation changes in this work package.
All three Wave 1 workers use the same exact launch merge as their implementation base.
Wave 1 role write scopes are disjoint; shared architecture and v4 contract files are read-only.
Integration-only build, source-manifest and workflow paths remain reserved to the later fan-in integrator.
No Wave 1 worker may merge itself or silently repair another role.
The Student V0.1 student candidate remains NOT_READY after this launch package.
requiredEvidence: Repository governance passes on the exact launch-package head.
PR scope passes against this exact coordination work package.
The three subordinate prompts cite the same frozen interface and require exact-base rebinding before implementation.
No overlapping writable implementation path exists between the three subordinate work packages.
adversarialTests: Any apps, authoring, contracts, workflow, governance-state or tools change fails launch-package scope.
Any child package made executable before binding the exact post-launch base fails governance.
Any shared writable implementation path across child roles blocks launch.
Any child permission to edit source_manifest or central workflows before fan-in blocks launch.
nonGoals: Implementing any Student V0.1 product capability.
Qualifying or promoting a learner candidate.
Changing the frozen v4 contract or prior v2/v3 meanings.
independentReview: Repository governance validates the durable work-package structure independently of the prompt author.
PR-scope automation validates the exact changed-path boundary.
The later fan-in integrator must independently verify exact child heads and path disjointness before combination.
rollback: Close the launch PR and delete the launch branch. The accepted Student V0.1 architecture remains on main, while all Wave 1 implementation roles remain unstarted.
